purpose: Record that the Foundation-v2 semantic research chain is coherent enough to stop spawning foundation alternatives and begin one production/reference migration design gate, without publishing a new accepted production MTS contract yet.

foundationDirection.ontology: all semantic entities are links or explicit networks of links; host classes may implement/check but do not define semantic identity
foundationDirection.root: distinguished R/O/C/L/U bootstrap with R=R⟼R; topology relative to exact distinguished occurrences, not shape-global uniqueness
foundationDirection.meaningBoundary: exact referent + optional root-relative Anum structural view + explicit contextual D/T/act relations; no Meaning(x) payload primitive
foundationDirection.anum: finite root-relative occurrence-tree structural description on its accepted domain; not universal identity for arbitrary shared/cyclic asets
foundationDirection.relationForms: self-closure is ostensive structural form; construction/projection/check/search are resolution directions under explicit bindings
foundationDirection.context: persistent explicit K with current selected through the interpreter act; no hidden parent stack or process-global current
foundationDirection.source: UTF-8 bytes → canonical byte links → canonical astring content C + exact source occurrence S
foundationDirection.language: selected segmentation and grammar/theory membership are explicit replay evidence; no token enum/AST opcode semantic identity
foundationDirection.dictionary: explicit scoped link network; source/content and form remain distinct
foundationDirection.theory: explicit membership/admission network; axiom membership does not imply unrestricted rewrite
foundationDirection.act: I and actual A are distinct occurrences; finite structural bootstrap identifies role vocabulary/context boundary; extensible roles are dictionary-resolved
foundationDirection.run: exact adjacent persistent contexts chain acts; adjacency is not logical transitivity
foundationDirection.definition: colon effect is explicit persistent scoped dictionary change with distinct occurrence evidence
foundationDirection.equality: context-local representative constraint; relation decomposition only via separately admitted one-step rule; no automatic congruence/substitution/transitivity
foundationDirection.search: candidate enumeration/ranking untrusted; exact selected evidence replayed read-only

gatePRequirements: define one production-facing typed/storage-neutral link and exact-occurrence substrate
define one parser/source front-end that preserves the selected Foundation-v2 source→D/G/T→act boundary
implement one reference interpreter/replay path over explicit K/D/T/A without parallel legacy semantic modes
classify every historical accepted behavior as preserved, intentionally changed, or historical replay-only
define explicit L4 mapping without making persistent numeric/address identity semantic identity
publish integrated conformance vectors before production cutover
migrate consumers atomically enough to delete obsolete semantic paths in the same program
only after accepted production contract allow aprover/AVM MTS-dependent repin
